A gem waiting to be discovered....
Jan 2024 • Solo
By chance I stumbled upon this vegetarian restaurant - a little out of the way, set back from the road. It was my second last meal of a weekend visit, and it turned out to be the most delicious of the trip. Being unfamiliar with Vietnamese food names, I chose something I recognised-ish "Phở nấm hầu" but was told they had run out. Was I ok with "Bún Huế"? Not going to lie, the photo and description of Bún Huế were a bit underwhelming. Oh well, c'est la vie. The soup that was placed before me was beautifully presented, and also wonderfully delicious! What luck! A tasty spicy, salty broth with delicious woody mushrooms, tofu and mock meat. I immediately sent photos to friends raving about this yummy soup! To top off the meal, a memorable thick strong coffee - made to my taste with rich condensed milk. I rarely write reviews, and am a committed omnivore - but I feel the world at large really must know of this delighful restaurant. Highly recommended!

Possibly my best meal in Vietnam !
Jan 2024 • Solo
The food lords smiled on me when I stumbled upon this place. I had no expectations but it was quite possibly my best meal in Vietnam!

Extensive and interesting food menu and very innovative (non alcoholic) drinks menu including homemade iced teas from exotic Vietnamese fruits.

I had the stewed pepper straw mushrooms - you can see in the photos they even use fresh pepper berries!

The food is wholesome and so delicious.

The staff were great and you can see they clearly have high standards when it comes to food.
